QuestInfo.name: Stylist Vincent VI
QuestInfo.0: Vincent wants more accessories to accentuate Vicky's beauty. You begrudgingly help him, hoping against hope that you'll learn something about the Spirit of Rock.
QuestInfo.1: Vincent wants to give Vicky one of the fedoras often worn by Male Mannequins. Bring #b70 Fedoras#k to Vicky.
QuestInfo.2: Vicky bizarrely loved the fedoras as well. So, a singer wearing a Bunny Suit, fedora and a blonde wig? Now you're just confused.

0.0: Really? REALLY? Vicky liked it? She really liked it? Excellent, excellent this romance scenario is unfolding just as I planned... (He rubs his hands together maniacally)
0.1: Last, but not least: I need an item to really bring out Vicky's intellectual side. You're still gonna help me, right?

yes.0: Bring Vicky #b70 Fedoras#k. You can find them on Male Mannequins, they like to wear them sometimes.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

1.0: You're still getting those Fedoras for me, right?

0.msg: So let me get this straight: I'm wearing a blonde wig and a fedora, in a freaking bunny suit?

1.msg: Whatevs, don't matter. My beauty will shine in any outfit!

2.msg: (Then why did she ask to be styled? Sigh.)

npc.0: Bring Vicky #b70 Fedoras#k. You can find them on Male Mannequins, they like to wear them sometimes.

item.0: I think Vicky still needs some kind of accessory. Something that will really stand out.
